assets.name: advisory
assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: original conceptual editorial photograph for a sophisticated bilingual foodservice design and advisory website, not documentation of a completed client project.
Primary request: An oblique close view of a calm architect's working table that conveys planning and independent decision making. Include blank folded plan paper with only extremely faint, non-legible abstract architectural linework, a subtle physical scale model of a complete stainless preparation counter, and a closed restrained deep teal notebook. The small model must represent a full preparation counter with legs, a lower shelf and cupboard, made from believable architectural model materials.
Style and composition: sophisticated real architectural and material photography, landscape 3:2, 1536 by 1024 pixels. A composed close view with natural perspective and elegant believable objects, soft focus falloff but the counter model and folded papers legible as physical objects. Keep the scene calm and restrained.
Lighting and palette: soft neutral daylight, pale stone and off-white work surface, brushed stainless accents, one restrained deep teal #0D5B63 notebook.
Constraints: no people, no hands, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no labels, no watermark, no readable markings anywhere. The plan linework is abstract and faint, never a readable drawing. No UI, no chart, no diagram, no infographic, no artificial engineering arrows. Avoid glossy CGI appearance, visual clutter, excessive decoration and fake project evidence.
assets.quality_review: Visually inspected generated output: requested subject is present, no people, no readable text or labels, full landscape composition.

assets.name: coordination
assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: original conceptual editorial architectural photograph for a sophisticated bilingual foodservice design and advisory website, not documentation of a completed client project.
Primary request: An architectural view of a complete realistic stainless commercial kitchen preparation wall and counter, with a discreet visible service zone that demonstrates credible integrated relationships between equipment, ventilation and extraction, water, and electrical services. Show a full preparation counter and undercounter storage, a modest integrated sink at one end, integrated refrigerated equipment and a compact cooking zone beneath a realistic extraction canopy. The visible extraction duct connects cleanly to the ceiling; plumbing is routed within a protected service zone; electrical service is conveyed by enclosed conduit and flush service outlets without markings. All equipment has realistic build, scale, spacing and connections.
Style and composition: sophisticated real architectural and material photography, landscape 3:2, 1536 by 1024 pixels. A quiet three-quarter architectural view wide enough to show the complete counter and service wall, believable room geometry, no extreme wide-angle distortion. This is a calm conceptual example of coordinated foodservice infrastructure.
Lighting and palette: soft neutral daylight, pale stone and off-white walls and floor, brushed stainless steel equipment, a restrained small deep teal #0D5B63 accent in the background.
Constraints: no people, no hands, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no labels, no watermark, no readable markings or displays. No exposed live wires, loose cables or leaking water. No colored engineering arrows, annotations, UI, chart, diagram, table or infographic. Avoid glossy CGI appearance, visual clutter, hazardous installation and fake project evidence.

assets.name: materials
assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: original conceptual editorial material photograph for a sophisticated bilingual foodservice design and advisory website, not documentation of a completed client project.
Primary request: A premium full stainless fabrication composition featuring one continuous complete counter and workbench with an integrated lower shelf and cupboard. The entire object is visible, including the whole continuous worktop, all legs, the lower shelf and cupboard. Beside it, place a few neat unbranded material samples on a pale surface, including a small restrained deep teal sample. Emphasize brushed metal grain, precise folded edges, refined joints and realistic fabrication.
Style and composition: sophisticated real architectural and material photography, landscape 3:2, 1536 by 1024 pixels. Calm three-quarter view of a complete useful fabrication object in a pale minimal architectural setting. Detail should remain crisp enough to appreciate steel grain and folded edges without cropping the object. This must be a complete counter, not an isolated sink.
Lighting and palette: soft neutral daylight, pale stone and off-white surfaces, brushed stainless steel, one restrained small deep teal #0D5B63 material sample.
Constraints: no people, no hands, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no labels, no watermark, no readable markings anywhere. No isolated sink, no UI, no chart, no diagram, no table graphic, no engineering arrows, no annotations. Avoid glossy CGI appearance, mirror chrome, unnecessary props, visual clutter and fake project evidence.
